name: Mima and Nina's Chocolate Workshop
source:
It's Valentine's Day, which means it's time to make chocolate to give to somebody special! Your best friends, Mima and Nina, are here to help you out. Listen to their tips and make the perfect chocolate!

・・・

Mima and Nina's Chocolate Workshop is a chocolate-making visual novel. Test different ingredients and decorations to tailor your chocolates to the tastes of the people you want to give them to.

There's your friend in the garden club, the tennis club captain, and the school president... But you only have one bag of chocolates to give!

Who will you give your chocolates to this Valentine's Day?

[From [url=https://npckc.itch.io/mima-and-ninas-chocolate-workshop]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
情人节到了，是时候亲手制作巧克力，送给那个特别的人了！最好的朋友米玛和妮娜会来帮忙。听取她们的建议，做出最完美的巧克力吧！

……

《米玛与妮娜的巧克力工坊》是一款制作巧克力的视觉小说。尝试不同的原料与装饰，根据收礼人的喜好，调制专属的巧克力。

你可以送给园艺社的朋友、网球社社长，还有学生会长……可你手里只有一袋巧克力！

这个情人节，你会把巧克力送给谁呢？

[译自[url=https://npckc.itch.io/mima-and-ninas-chocolate-workshop]itch.io[/url]]
